notes:
Summary: Quillbridge is building a customer support deflection layer + agent assist. Corpus ~30M short docs (kb articles, past tickets). Primary KPI: increase self-serve deflection by 15% and improve agent time-to-resolution. Tight latency SLOs: target end-to-end p95 <= 350ms for query+top-5 reranking in production; p50 target ~60-120ms. Cost target: <$0.02 per query at projected 300M annual queries.

POC specifics / observations:
- Using hosted API for rapid iteration, but leaning to Dedicated (reserved pool) if latency and burst guarantees are strong. VPC required for production, legal insists on data residency for EU traffic.
- Indexing: plan incremental refresh every 6 hrs, initial full index ~30M docs, avg doc length ~120 tokens. Expect vector index size ~1.2TB (float16) before quantization.
- Retrieval pipeline: hybrid lexical filter -> dense ANN (HNSW) -> bi-encoder rerank -> quantized cross-encoder top-5 rerank. Want to keep cross-encoder latency <120ms p95 by using batchable quantized kernels and short-seq optimizations.
- Metrics tracked in POC: top-5 Precision@5, NDCG@5, end-to-end p95 latency, tokens billed per call, cost per query estimate.
- Early results: bi-encoder recall good, cross-encoder improves top-5 relevance significantly but currently doubles latency; SE suggested 8-bit quantized model + token pruning to hit latency SLOs.

Security / compliance notes:
- Quillbridge requires SSO (Okta SAML), KMS integration for keys, audit logging for queries and index changes, and a signed DPA with EU data residency terms. Legal asking for on-prem option for specific regulated customers.

Sales chatter / quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need answers in under 300ms or agents will not adopt the assist flow" — Head of Support (A. Moreno).
- "Cost sensitivity is real; finance expects a clear unit cost model before committing to Dedicated" — VP Product (S. Huang).

POC blockers & open asks for Redwood:
- Provide benchmark report for quantized cross-encoder (p95 latency at 1 CPU/1 GPU config) using 512 token cross-encoder and 32 batch size
- Draft of VPC architecture diagram including KMS flow and audit log retention options
- Detailed cost model: per-query breakdown (retrieval + bi-encoder + cross-encoder) and expected savings with Optimize suggestions (caching + prefix reuse)

Next steps (near term):

- Run live A/B with 5% traffic for two weeks after hitting p95 <= 350ms in staging
- Legal to review DPA (target sign-off by 2026-04)
